results.title: Notion Ai More For Less | VibeLeaderboard
results.content:
Notion says it rebuilt its agents for efficiency, and the announcement bundles several changes. Agents can now run a single task for more than 24 hours. A new Auto model routing mode picks the model for each step, and Notion claims it delivers near-frontier results at about 90% lower cost; that figure is the company's own and comes without an outside comparison. Notion also added bring-your-own AI, letting ChatGPT plans and MCP servers connect to its agents. On the billing side, Business and Enterprise seats move to a credit system with Standard and Select tiers and admin controls over how credits are spent. The combination is the point: longer-running agents consume more model calls, and the credit tiers plus routing are how Notion keeps that affordable and lets administrators cap it. [...] Notion says its upgraded Auto router delivered results similar to Opus 5.5 and Astra across 20+ common use cases at about 90% lower average cost, and re-routes to another model when one stops making progress on a task.
 Business and Enterprise seats now include 1,500 Standard credits a month for Auto-routed work and 500 Select credits for chosen models or Custom Agents, kept separate so heavy agent runs cannot exhaust everyday usage.
 The sixth-generation Notion agent harnessThe scaffolding around a model that turns it into a working agent — the loop, the tools it can call, and the rules for when to stop.Full definition → runs each session on a queue-backed durable worker loop, which Notion says lets a single task run for more than 24 hours, up from five minutes.

results.title: Notion AI Rebuilt: 24-Hour Agents, Auto, New Credits | CellCog
results.content:
1. A clock with a long arc around it.

   Notion rebuilt Notion Agent and Custom Agents on October 19, 2026, its sixth agent harness. A single task can now run for more than 24 hours, up from five minutes.
2. One path splitting into a thin lane and a thick lane.

   Its upgraded Auto router sends easy work to cheap models and hard work to capable ones. Notion says it matched Opus 5.5 and Astra on 20+ use cases at about 90% lower average cost.
3. Two coin stacks, one tall, one short.

   Business and Enterprise seats now get two monthly pools: 1,500 Standard credits when Notion picks the model and 500 Select credits when you pick it or run Custom Agents. Neither rolls over.
4. A small meter beside a large one. [...] Notion rebuilt its agents on October 19, 2026, and the headline is time: a Notion agent can now work on one task for more than 24 hours, up from five minutes. Co-founder Akshay Kothari’s post bundles that with an upgraded model router called Auto, a way to pay with an existing ChatGPT plan, an admin dashboard for AI spend, and a new credit system that splits every seat’s AI allowance into two pools. [...] ## § 01What changed, in one table#

| Change | Before | After |
 --- 
| Longest single agent task | Five minutes | More than 24 hours |
| Tools agents can reach | A few dozen earlier this summer | Hundreds, via MCPs and connectors |
| Model choice | Pick a model, or Auto | Upgraded Auto, about 90% lower cost on Notion’s tests |
| Custom Agent run cost | Baseline | About 30% less in Notion’s testing |
| App speed | Baseline | Up to 50% faster on web and mobile |
| Paying with outside AI | Not offered | ChatGPT Plus, Pro or Go in the personal Notion Agent; Enterprise bring-your-own-key in alpha |
